name: Leila Chastity
original_name: レイラ・チャスティティ
source:
Selena's daughter. An up-and-coming knight with a reputation of being just as skilled as her mother.

She's hard-working and proud.

She has a strong desire not to bring shame to her mother's name, but also tends to act rashly.
